newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising at attractive prices.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising at attractive prices.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are expected to rise on Monday with prices at attractive levels after last week's brief market correction, brokers said. "Investors see prices are attractive after the shares fell on profit-taking last week," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. But brokers said some investors might remain cautious ahead of Thursday's budget.

The DSE all-share price index rose 26.07 points, or 2.32 percent, to 1,167.91 on Sunday on turnover of 67.8 milllion taka. Friday and Saturday are the weekend in Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
